newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S. Korea's LG Group to invest 60 trln won by 2000.
newsitem.headline: S. Korea's LG Group to invest 60 trln won by 2000.

text.p: South Korea's LG Group said on Thursday it would invest 60 trillion won by the year 2000 to achieve 130 trillion won in turnover.
A group statement said it targetted 300 trillion won sales in 2005.
LG said 50 trillion won would be spent on facility investment and the rest on research and development.

It said 18 trillion won would go to semiconductor business, 12 trillion to electronics, 13 trillion to energy and chemical, three trillion to construction and distribution, and the remainder to other business fields.
LG said 40 percent of its total investment would go to development of high technology instruments, such as computer chips and liquid crystal displays.
The group also plans to close down 90 businesses that have underperformed. It did not name the businesses.
